data.long_description:
The Crestmark is a contemporary urban retreat located in Dubai's vibrant Business Bay, offering a harmonious blend of tranquility and city living. This 18-story tower, featuring a striking double-height atrium, artfully merges the natural beauty of metal, glass, and wood to create a refined yet artistic aesthetic. With studios and 1 to 4-bedroom apartments available, each residence is designed for modern living. The open-plan layout seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas, enhancing both visibility and versatility. Expansive balconies extend your living space outdoors, providing a serene spot to unwind. The interiors are a perfect blend of elegance and functionality, while the bathrooms, equipped with contemporary fixtures, offer a spa-like experience that epitomizes luxury.

It features indoor and outdoor yoga areas, an outdoor garden, a work lobby, a lounge pool with canal views, a children's playground, a secret club room, a retro game room, and a fitness studio with views of the landscaped pools. The complex is a five-minute drive from Business Bay Metro Station and Dubai Mall / Burj Khalifa.

Finance is available on this property through Premier Property Finance. Call us on +97143233609 for a free consultation.
